title: Semantic Kernel Python in-memory vector filters can execute code
summary: Microsoft identifies remote code execution in the Python SDK InMemoryVectorStore filter functionality. Versions before 1.39.4 are affected.

severity.rationale: Code execution requires the affected vector-store filter functionality; the vendor vector specifies low privileges. Agent retrieval workflows accepting untrusted filters can meet this prerequisite.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.

exposure: Applications using InMemoryVectorStore filters are exposed. The advisory does not establish that every Semantic Kernel integration permits attacker-controlled filtering.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 1.39.4 or later. Microsoft recommends avoiding InMemoryVectorStore in production as a workaround.
remediation.risk: Updating or replacing the store requires retrieval compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm semantic-kernel is at least 1.39.4 and test dependent retrieval workflows.
